description: One original square icon from the saved game art direction, delivered as PNG, macOS ICNS and Windows ICO in the Library. get returns the latest complete pack. quote prices generation; run queues it after the quoted cost is accepted. Existing icons are reused for free unless regenerate=true. Poll the returned job with gripforge_generation_read. Use files for direct and Steam builds; Steam store artwork is separate.

action.description: get reads the saved pack; quote prices it; run queues the accepted quote.

expected_revision.description: Project revision returned by quote, required for generation.

idempotency_key.description: Stable request key for retries; use a new key for a distinct request.

project_id.description: Game Kit project id (gkp_…). Not a dedicated-server project (gpj_…) nor a Library item.

regenerate.description: Generate a new icon instead of reusing the saved pack.

workspace_id.description: Workspace authorized by the current key. Never infer another user’s workspace.

name: gripforge_game_app_icon
title: Generate or reuse the app icon of a game
